title: David Grusch testimony and ICIG report

tellings.quote: Wait a second. Didn't David Grusch raise his hand and say that we have been generationally exploiting non-human technology hand to God and to country

plain: A former intelligence officer named David Grusch swore before Congress that the United States has been "generationally exploiting non-human technology," the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell reminds Michels, describing him raising his hand to take the oath. Corbell sets this beside a report from the inspector general who watches over the US spy agencies, an office known as the ICIG, which he brings up as backing for Grusch. If Grusch is right, the government has held technology made by someone other than humans for generations.
